The Museum is a a Location found within the  Village on the Hub Island. It serves as a place for players to donate items in exchange for turning them Co-op Soulbound and SkyBlock XP.

Purpose

[edit | edit source]

The Museum allows players to donate items to Madame Eleanor Q. Goldsworth III. When an accepted item is donated for the first time, the player is rewarded with permanent SkyBlock XP, and the item becomes Co-op Soulbound, meaning it cannot be traded with anyone outside of the player's Co-op (if they have one).

More valuable items reward more SkyBlock XP. The Museum is split into categories based on Skills, including  Combat,  Farming,  Mining,  Fishing,  Foraging,  Dungeoneering, and  Hunting. There is also a Special Items category, in which items donated do not reward any SkyBlock XP, nor become become Co-op Soulbound. This category has a limit of 48 items.

Armor and Equipment sets can only be donated as a complete set, meaning individual pieces cannot be donated alone. When an item is donated, its creation date, date of donation, and position number (when below 50,000) can be seen. If an item is one of the first 1,000 created, then its number can be seen above the item when displayed in the Museum in one of the display cases.

Players on Stranded and Bingo profiles cannot access the Museum.

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • There was a window of time, ending with October 15, 2024 during which it was possible to donate items that shared the name of an armor set as an alternative to the full set of armor. This was possible with:  Pumpkin as  Pumpkin Armor,  Cactus as  Cactus Armor,  Glacite as  Glacite Armor,  Melon as  Melon Armor,  Cropie as  Cropie Armor,  Squash as  Squash Armor,  Sponge as  Sponge Armor,  Sorrow as  Sorrow Armor and  Fermento as  Fermento Armor.[1]
    • This was not possible with items such as  Lapis Lazuli, because its armor set is called  Lapis Armor, rather than Lapis Lazuli Armor. Similarly it didn't work with  Emerald because its armor is called  Emerald Armor Helmet and not just "Emerald Helmet".
    • Donating these items would soulbound them and store them in the museum.
